text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
First up, chunky whole cabbage skewers~♪
Let's Buono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, soo healthy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand, crunchy-crunch~♪
Crispy-crisp~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Next up is whole-grilled lobster and king salmon~♪ Let's Bono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, soo fresh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand, plump and tender~♪
Fluffy and warm~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And last but not least! Everyone's absolute favorite,
a hefty whole-roasted meat~♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, juicy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wow!
Sizzle~♪ Sizzle-sizzle~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Pearl-senpai, you make it sound like
some English term, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you listen closely,
isn't that a really weird phrasing?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Also, aren't all the ingredients
Akebono is grilling way too huge...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh...!! Once I started overthinking it,
I started worrying about everythinggg!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I agree with that, Hishi Ama-senpai. But... if you start questioning it, there'll be no end to it, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And with that, El Condor Pasa
is ready to rolllllllll!!!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, El is right.
We must strike while the iron is hot, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the meat is ready~!
Don't be shy, eat as muuuuch as you want♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, true enough.
It'd be a real waste not to enjoy that meat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Alright, decided! Let's just enjoy today without worrying about the little things! Let's go, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...However, we must be careful not to eat too much and affect your races, okay~♪
